abstract: An ultrastructural examination of five syncytiotrophoblast-like cells (STLC) from three otherwise pure seminomas was performed. All five STLC demonstrated ultrastructural features identical to those of normal syncytiotrophoblastic cells. The STLC were surrounded by sinusoidal spaces and cells whose ultrastructure was compatible with that of seminoma cells, though the presence of cytotrophoblastic cells cannot be excluded with certainty. We conclude that STLC in seminomas are indeed syncytiotrophoblastic and their genesis remains an enigma.
abstract_ja: 純粋セミノーマ3例から得た合胞体栄養膜様細胞(STLC)5個について超微細構造の検討を行った。5個すべてが正常の合胞体栄養膜細胞と同一の超微細構造を示した。STLCは類洞様の空間とセミノーマ様の細胞に囲まれていた。細胞性栄養膜細胞の存在は確実には除外できなかった。セミノーマ内のSTLCは真に合胞体栄養膜性であると結論したが、その発生は依然として不明である。
